perspective:
Bradley’s available information:

- He is a salesperson at the marketing firm, and Katherine is his colleague/marketing manager. Their working relationship is professional and generally cordial, but he has experienced tension/frustration over disagreements about traditional sales versus digital marketing.
- In their meeting, he had prepared data and charts from the last five campaigns. He told Katherine he appreciated her digital strategies but believed traditional sales methods were being overlooked. He heard Katherine acknowledge his point, say the market is evolving, mention increasing online engagement, and suggest analyzing the data together to integrate both approaches.
- After the meeting, Katherine shared recent digital campaign success stories/results. Bradley found them impressive and became uncertain about relying only on traditional methods. He asked her to explain how those strategies were developed. He heard her describe targeting the right audience with the right message and offering to walk him through the analytics and decision-making. He admitted his doubts and said he wanted to understand digital more; she said she was glad and that adapting to market trends matters.
- He later felt hopeful and proposed a joint strategy session. Katherine agreed, saying combining strengths could lead to better results. He said he appreciated her willingness to collaborate; she said she looked forward to leveraging each other’s strengths.
- After a joint meeting, he was excited and worked overtime to prepare a board presentation draft integrating both ideas. He told Katherine about it; she praised it as comprehensive and well thought out. He said he was convinced the integrated approach would set them apart from competitors. She said she was confident and suggested reviewing and fine-tuning it.
- After the presentation and implementation, he felt grateful for his professional growth and the collaboration. He thanked Katherine and said he had learned much from her. She said it had been a pleasure and that his openness made the partnership successful. He proposed regular strategy sessions; she agreed, saying they would keep them on top of the game and market trends.
